summary: Skill quick-dev-tdd-adapter applies only to explicit execution-plans targets with schema-valid implementation-contract.v1.json; parent route must use caller quick-dev-tdd-adapter and yield strict_tdd_plan/backend quick-dev-tdd-adapter; inspect only target plan directory and resolve at most one 95-*.md report; reports/run-state are non-authoritative; audit and repair before identity freeze; run loop_plan_directory.py before expensive actions; run slices through generated run_context and run_slice_lifecycle.py; observe expected failing RED before production writes, then GREEN, REFACTOR, and plan-local predicate; no hand-authored lifecycle evidence; stop only at implementation-complete, external-repair-required, or repeated failure fingerprint; acceptance/commit/release remain external; consume skill input via prepared typed receipt/request and require ready validation; classify architectural/complex/small_mechanical/normal with unknowns blocked complex; decisions are non-authorizing and canonical policy controls execution; verify frozen knowledge hashes before RED; persistent loop requires explicit existing execution_snapshot_paths and exact planned_new_files handling; use shell-free structured commands; preserve failed evidence as stale-linked successors; read referenced backend, TDD protocol, and evidence documents before implementation; version-sensitive dependency changes require exact-version Context7 verification before commit; repository-owned-only changes make version gate not applicable
